bayts.text: And make my writing, from this day, above an accepted prayer and fast.
And unveil through my writing what has been hidden of the sciences: You are the All-Aware, the Great and the All-Knowing.
And make me free, through You and the accepted Intercessor, of every wrongdoer and every cannon.
And make my compositions like a guide, and heal my body and guide my heart.
You have taken what I sold of myself at the (agreed) price, without revocation; You have made time good for me.
To You, without complaint, from me, gratitude, O You Who granted me my desire, O Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr).
And bless, O All-Merciful, and grant peace upon him through whom You loosed my pain,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make clear for me my waking and my sleep, and drive toward others than me what draws reproach.
And make my movements and stillnesses, for You, more beloved than all good deeds,
without calamity and without turbidity, O Lord of creation, of the Decree and of Destiny.
And bless, O Most Merciful, with peace, him whom You sent possessed of teaching,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness for me, today and after today, to every good, and protect me from reproach.
And on my behalf reward the Chosen with a good that surpasses (all), in the present and the final outcome, O best Companion.
And on my behalf reward the people of Badr, perpetually, with abundant good; and make my writing praiseworthy.
And on my behalf reward his Family and his Companions with abundant good, and illumine his road through me.
And on my behalf reward Your noble hosts with abundant good: You have led my aim to me.
And on my behalf reward the Prophets and the Messengers with abundant good, and increase the most perfect through me.
And on my behalf reward my parents and all whom my joy has gladdened, with good things, O All-Hearing.
And have mercy on all the saints and the community, and lift the distress that has befallen (them).
And occupy Your enemies with other than what corrupts the way of Your Prophet, and repel those who have envied.
And occupy Your enemies with Your enemies, and turn their hearts from harming whoever knows You.
And turn the hearts of the idolaters to other than harming those who have done good, all alike.
And occupy Your servants in doing what is commanded, not in breaking into the forbidden, O Possessor of Command.
And bless, O Allah, with a blessing that sends what grieves us toward others than us, and it goes,
with a peace that draws gladness to us and brings evils to others than our person,
upon Your Prophet and Your servant, the Messenger, who led to me from You, Lord, the best of requests.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make, by his mighty standing with You, my writing a lasting gladness for Your hosts.
And make my writing lasting glad tidings for the Chosen, whose servant I have become.
And make through him my writing gladnesses forever, for all the angels, O You Who are worshipped.
And make my writing with You lasting good (works) (Qurʾān 18:46), never ceasing to grow.
And turn away through it the accursed, the enemies and illness toward others than me, forever.
And draw to me through it, forever, wherever I am, without harm or heartache: "Be!" and it is.
And bless, O All-Merciful, perpetually, him through whom You led the heights to whoever rose high,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to the Family and the Companions; and teach my heart.
O You Who through him have made my heart and my hand the two vessels of Your Book, and so they became,
and through my life You drive fear and shame toward a direction other than mine, forever,
and You have bestowed on me, today and after today, that through which I have become the glad tidings of the people,
without harm, nor neglect, nor rancour, just as through him You spared me whoever criticised;
and for me You have been, in all movements and stillnesses, good deeds and blessings;
and You have led to me, in all customs, beyond the wishes of Your servants, the masters.
And bless, O Most Merciful, with peace, the son of ʿAbd Allāh, possessed of teaching,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You with Whom You have purified, without toil, my intention, my word and my deed,
and You have led to me beyond request and wishes, and I have surpassed the people of ʿArafāt and Minā;
O You Who have made my pen a proof (ḥujja) for me, from the beginning of the year until Dhū l-Ḥijja;
O You Who have made for me every day above an accepted prayer and fast,
and for me have made, through You, every month above the worship of creatures through time,
and for me have made every season and year above the good of those who persevered in good deeds.
